title: Complications of self-drilling intermaxillary fixation screws with a focus on dental root damage
html: Intermaxillary fixation is often used in oral and maxillofacial surgery for temporary jaw stabilization. Self-drilling intermaxillary fixation screws are easy to use but can cause dental damage. This retrospective study was performed to examine the complications associated with self-drilling screws, with a focus on dental root damage. Overall, 274 screws were placed in 43 patients between 2010 and 2023 at University Medical Center Utrecht. Patients with missing postoperative imaging or screws placed in edentulous areas were excluded, leaving 162 screws in 28 patients for evaluation.
